actual_finding_details.finding: The additive BED SDCS integrates over the slow-electron half-domain to the frozen total. H analytic oscillator and original printed He coefficients supply the same Ni, K and D used by the implementation. Two daughters and binding ledger preserve event energy and one added free electron. Parent transport is unchanged.

Actual2400/4800-node evidence supports the reported paired representation response within the frozen empirical numerical criteria.
